subject: Post-call recap: GranitePay security evidence, DPA sequencing & timelines
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@granitepay.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-17T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: GranitePay security evidence, DPA sequencing & timelines

Hi Marta — thanks again for the call today. Quick written recap so we have a shared playbook and owners. Please flag anything I missed.

TL;DR (what you asked for):
- SOC 2 report and supporting artifacts (scope mapping)
- Audit log schema / sample (retention and export options)
- DPA redline + sequencing for signing before pilot
- Pen-test summary and remediation owners

Key pain points you raised:
- Required 12+ months of immutable audit log retention and exports for regulator review.
- Need assurance on what artifacts Redwood can provide for SOC 2 (control mappings, evidence, bridge letters).
- Contract timing: procurement needs a DPA and commercial terms in hand by July 10 to meet your Aug 15 pilot launch.
- Pen-test evidence: redacted report + remediation plan required for internal risk acceptance.

What Redwood will deliver (next steps / owners):
1) Evidence matrix (initial set) — delivered by Soojin; ETA: 2027-06-21. Owner: Soojin Lee (infosec).
2) Audit-log sample & schema + retention options doc — delivered by Ben; ETA: 2027-06-21. Owner: Ben Carter (solutions).
3) DPA redline to your procurement — Rachel to circulate proposed sequencing and draft by 2027-06-22; target signature by 2027-07-10. Owner: Rachel Kim (sales).
4) Pen-test summary (redacted) + brief on patch cadence — attached (pen-test-summary-Redwood.pdf). Soojin will clarify any open CVEs and timelines.
5) Kick off evidence intake workspace (shared Drive + tracking) — I’ll create the Drive folder and share a DocuSign link placeholder for contracting. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-evidence-intake

Small asks for you so we can prioritize:
- Confirm primary security contact(s) and a mailbox we should send the evidence to (we’ll zip & SFTP for anything sensitive).
- Any regulatory-specific retention exception requests (if 24+ months is required, note that so we map storage/archival options).

Attachments: redwood-infosec-pack.zip (contains SOC 2 summary, incident response overview, data flow diagrams), pen-test-summary-Redwood.pdf (redacted).

Proposed immediate meeting: 30-min tech Q&A (Soojin + Ben + your security lead) — calendar options: 2027-06-22 09:30-10:00 PT or 2027-06-23 11:00-11:30 PT. Let me know what works.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the DPA draft and evidence matrix early next week.

--
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@granitepay.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@granitepay.com
Date: 2027-06-17T18:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: GranitePay security evidence, DPA sequencing & timelines

Thanks Rachel — good recap. A couple of clarifications and requests from our side: 

1) Primary security contact: security@granitepay.com (internal: Jorge Ramos, Lead InfoSec). Please send evidence and questions there.
2) Retention: Regulator guidance expects 18 months for some transaction trails; defaulting to 18 months (we can accept shorter for certain event types, but need to see the mapping).
3) SOC2: we need the actual Type II report (most recent) plus at least two control artifacts (e.g., change management ticket history and an incident response runbook). We can accept redacted PII.
4) Audit logs: can you provide a sample row or two of the export (redacted) and a schema description (fields/timestamps/timezone)? Also want to confirm whether logs can be exported as weekly bundles for long-term archival.
5) Pen test: thanks for the summary doc — can you highlight which CVEs were classified P1/P2 in the last year and which are still open?

Contract timing: procurement will try to have DPA redline complete by Jul 10. If Redwood needs additional time to complete any evidence items, call out what would block that date.

I attached our security roster (GranitePay-Security-Roster.xlsx) with names and availability. For the tech Q&A, the morning slot on 6/22 works for Jorge — please send a calendar invite.

– Marta
Marta Lopez
Head of Procurement & Security Operations
GranitePay
marta.lopez@granitepay.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@granitepay.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-18T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: GranitePay security evidence, DPA sequencing & timelines

Hi Marta — looping in the tech details below and attaching the redacted pen-test summary.

Quick answers to your asks: 
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (report period: 2026-10 through 2027-03). We can provide the full report under an NDA/secure link and two representative control artifacts (change mgmt audit trail, access review spreadsheet) via the Drive folder.
- Audit logs: we can export audit logs as newline-delimited JSON or CSV. Sample fields: event_id, user_id (hashed), action, resource, timestamp (UTC), src_ip (redacted), request_id, kv_payload (redacted). We can produce weekly bundles (S3-compatible archive) for 18-month retention.
- Pen-test: attached pen-test-summary-Redwood.pdf — P1s were resolved within 30 days; current open items are P3/P4 mitigation items scheduled in our quarterly backlog. I’ll annotate the PDF with a short status table by COB 2027-06-18.

What I need from you to hit the Jul 10 DPA sign date: 
- Confirmation that 18 months is the target retention (yes/no). If yes, we’ll size archival and confirm any cost delta.
- Confirmation of the SFTP vs. secure Drive preference for receiving evidence. If SFTP, provide an account.
- Any special encryption/HSM requirements for keys (we support customer-managed KMS via your cloud provider; we can provide KMS rotation details).

Operational plan / proposed timeline: 
- 2027-06-18: Share annotated pen-test status (Soojin).
- 2027-06-21: Evidence matrix + audit-log schema + sample exports (Ben/Soojin).
- 2027-06-22: 30-min tech Q&A (09:30 PT) — meeting invite pending.
- 2027-06-22 to 2027-07-08: Evidence intake/review cycle (GranitePay reviews, asks follow-ups).
- 2027-07-10: Target DPA sign-off (procurement).

Attachments: pen-test-summary-Redwood.pdf (redacted).

If helpful, I can open a dedicated Jira project (we use JIRA) to track each evidence artifact — that usually speeds reviews. Let me know if you prefer that.

Thanks — see you on 6/22.

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Security Engineer, Risk & Controls
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@granitepay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: GranitePay security evidence, DPA sequencing & timelines

Perfect — 6/22 09:30 PT confirmed. We prefer secure Drive for the initial intake and will provide an SFTP account if we need larger bundles. 18 months is our target retention.

I’ve looped Jorge (security@granitepay.com) on the invite and he will review the annotated pen test. We’ll aim to complete the evidence review cycle by 2027-07-08 so procurement can sign the DPA on 7/10.

Marta
